title: Long Document Interpretability using Large Language Models via Hierarchical Version of Sha
summary: Builds on our TextGenSHAP release: scalable post-hoc explanations for text generation over long documents via hierarchical Shapley and Banzhaf values, with retrieval pipelines for NQ and MirACL and a FiD generation model. Goal is an explanation service for retrieval-augmented answers in the graphs-retrieval portfolio.
